pois.name: Crestview/Brentwood neighborhood strip
pois.description: A walkable stretch of small, independent shops, coffee, and record stores just off the corridor.

pois.name: North Loop shopping strip
pois.description: A short, walkable strip of vintage shops and casual food just west of the stop.

pois.name: University of Texas West Mall & Littlefield Fountain
pois.description: Open, walkable university grounds with a well-known public fountain and mall.

pois.name: Guadalupe St ("The Drag")
pois.description: A dense strip of shops and casual food across from campus.

pois.name: Texas State Capitol grounds
pois.description: Public state capitol building and grounds, open for walking and self-guided viewing.

pois.name: Congress Avenue Bridge
pois.description: Public bridge over Lady Bird Lake, known for its evening bat colony in warmer months.

pois.name: Lady Bird Lake Hike-and-Bike Trail access
pois.description: Public trail along the lake, walkable in either direction with no set route required.

pois.name: South Congress Avenue
pois.description: A well-known, walkable strip of shops, food, and street life on both sides of the avenue.
